//: Build/emit config. Unlike tsconfig.json (which maps @repo/* to sibling SOURCE for
//paths: editor + typecheck), this clears `paths` so @repo/* resolves to each dependency's
//built: built .d.ts (via node_modules), and pins rootDir to ./src — so output emits FLAT to
//flat: bin/ instead of nesting under bin/<pkg>/src when sibling source is pulled in.
//emit: These packages are CommonJS (no "type":"module") and are loaded by plain Node as well as bundlers. Dev/typecheck uses Bundler/ESNext (base.json), but the BUILD must emit CJS (module/moduleResolution Node16 below): ESNext emit writes `export … from './x'` into .js files, which Node treats as ESM and then can't resolve the extensionless relative path — breaking every Node consumer.
